mapper.update: update jy_user set login_ip = #{loginIp}, login_time = #{loginTime} where id = #{id}
update jy_user set avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
update jy_user set nick_name = #{userInfoBody.nickName}, sex = #{userInfoBody.sex}, email = #{userInfoBody.email}, birthday = #{userInfoBody.birthday}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.nick_name, u.account, u.password, u.email, u.avatar, u.sex, u.birthday, u.status, u.login_ip, u.login_time, u.create_time, u.update_time, r.id AS role_id, r.role_name FROM jy_user u LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN jy_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.account = #{userAccount}
